tailMarker.anomalyNote: The marker is a PRESERVATIVE at rank 11, four ranks ahead of Parfum @15 — one of only three cohort products (with #08 and #10) where the earliest tail-class ingredient is not the fragrance. This is consequential: it places BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @12, the formula's ONLY cationic surfactant, in the tail, leaving the credited segment with no cationic conditioning agent at all. No §3.1 anomaly by the letter (rank 11 > 3, and Cetearyl Alcohol @3 is a conditioning ingredient preceding the marker), but see AP-06-NOCATIONIC.  ||  PLAUSIBILITY ASSESSMENT (R2, §3.1.1, added under v0.2): PLAUSIBLE, with the counter-signal recorded. The species that establish this product's care and weight architecture - CETEARYL ALCOHOL @3, DIMETHICONE @4, DIMETHICONOL @5, ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE @6, BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII BUTTER @7, COCOS NUCIFERA OIL @8, SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS SEED OIL @9 - all outrank PHENOXYETHANOL @11, and the product is a conventional O/W emulsion with AQUA @1, so neither limb of §3.1.1 fires. What does sit below the marker is the formula's ONLY cationic surfactant, BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @12. That is an ordinary tail demotion of a single species, not a marker sitting before the architecture: the credited segment still carries a complete fatty-alcohol, silicone and lipid architecture on its own. It is recorded as a counter-signal and is the reason S1 fails (conditioningLevel), not a reason to void the marker. PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS OIL @10 is the tail_index - 1 species and is excluded from carrying a signal (R3).

S2 and S3 both fire, but R3 is explicit that S2 + S3 without S1 is `moderate`, because both read the fatty/emollient load that §9.2 owns — and here that load is said once, and loudly, in `weight_potential: high`. ISOPROPYL MYRISTATE (6), BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII (SHEA) BUTTER (7), COCOS NUCIFERA (COCONUT) OIL (8), SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS (JOJOBA) SEED OIL (9) — four distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids above the tail and above tail_index − 1: S3 satisfied with room to spare
PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS (SWEET ALMOND) OIL (rank 10) — at tail_index − 1, excluded from carrying a signal (R3); S3 fires without it

conditioningLevel.derivation: §9.1 (R3). S1 = NOT satisfied (zero distinct cationic surfactants above the tail). S2 = satisfied. S3 = satisfied on four species, three of which survive the tail-edge exclusion. Two signals fire; S1 is not one of them → `moderate`.
thresholdReasoning: Clears `moderate`: R3 assigns `moderate` to everything else, explicitly including S2 + S3 without S1.

`high` does not apply: S1 is mandatory and this formula's credited segment contains no cationic conditioning agent whatsoever — the strongest possible failure of the signal that reads conditioning BREADTH. v0.1 recorded this as AP-06-NOCATIONIC, a mask scoring the top conditioning value with no cationic in its credited segment; R3 closes it.
`low` does not apply: S2 and S3 both hold.

Material counter-signals checked and NOT fired: the marker is resolved and plausible; no §2.4.1 tier-2 conflict; no fired signal rests on a family-10 species (PEG-100 STEARATE @16 and GLYCERYL STEARATE @17 are both in the tail and were never counted).
counterSignals: The cationic demotion is a single-species, single-rank fact (BEHENTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @12 against PHENOXYETHANOL @11). §9.1 flags the width of the boundary band as an open calibration question; on a two-rank band this product would carry a cationic in its credited segment — though still only one, so S1 would fail anyway on breadth.
The 'ohne Silikone' claim is contradicted by DIMETHICONE @4, DIMETHICONOL @5 and AMODIMETHICONE @18 — recorded in `hinweise` as `claim_formula_mismatch`, moving no value (§11 step 4).
HYDROXYETHYLCELLULOSE @14 — a rheology-only species: a §9.1 NON-material counter-signal, recorded and explicitly not capping.
limitations: A three-step concentration scale is at the edge of INCI support; no published dataset maps INCI patterns to validated low/medium/high thresholds (§9.1 honest limitation).
Rank is used qualitatively only. EU Art. 19 hides the 1 % boundary; no percentage, ratio, dose or deposited amount is inferable.
Source is a database fallback tier (incibeauty); a same-name hautschutzengel page was found to be the SHAMPOO and was discarded rather than used.
